correctness.rationale: The exact normalized icosahedron has unique distance-three antipodes and 20 triangular faces, hence its graph-metric radius-one and radius-two Vietoris–Rips complexes are respectively the icosahedral boundary and six-crosspolytope boundary. The six-axis map A satisfies AA*=2I. Every radius-one face is supported in an affine plane strictly separated from the origin, so the explicit projected linear homotopy is everywhere defined and G-equivariant. Galois-conjugate U,W characters give identical integer subgroup invariant dimensions. Restricting the constructed homotopy yields all fixed-space inclusion maps. Exact group determinant calculation gives quotient rational homology. Standalone independent enumeration checks 120 symmetries and 164 subgroups; infinite/all-subgroup reasoning is analytical, not inferred from tests.

value.rationale: Determines a natural equivariant persistence map across distinct dimensions and completely classifies fixed-space filtrations for every subgroup of the full icosahedral symmetry group, including noncyclic and improper subgroups. It identifies a Galois-doubled 3+3 representation and exact vanishing of all integer fixed-point homology persistence maps—information invisible from stagewise ordinary Betti numbers and not simply another arbitrary low-dimensional invariant.
